angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 807,012.0 km at 17.357 pc = 0.622 mas. No interferometric diameter is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 57.6131 +/- 0.0383 mas (photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv), no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.16 +/- 0.04 solar radii and mass 1.23 +/- 0.12 solar masses: Bruntt et al. (2010, MNRAS 405, 1907), as tabulated by Alvarado-Gomez et al. (2018, MNRAS 473, 4326; arXiv:1710.02438), Table 1, the values the ZDI maps of this package were computed with. Temperature 6080 +/- 80 K from the same table. presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Bruntt et al. (2010), MNRAS 405, 1907: 6,080 +/- 80 K, as tabulated by Alvarado-Gomez et al. (2018), Table 1 (https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.02438)
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HR 810 (pscomppars): spectral type G0V, from Turnbull 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015arXiv151001731T/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, * iot Hor: main object type **, Double or Multiple Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HR 810 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.16 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HR 810 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.25309, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HR 810 (pscomppars): age 2.72 Gyr, from Turnbull 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015arXiv151001731T/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HR 810 (pscomppars): rotation period 7.9 d, from Pizzolato et al. 2003 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2003A&A...397..147P/abstract)
